name: Hollow Reed

stages.name: Notched
stages.note: The nicks in the edge have started to hold qi rather than lose it.

stages.name: Green
stages.note: Something in the metal has begun to behave like something alive.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.note: It is warm when you pick it up. It was not warm before.

description: A thin practice blade issued to every outer disciple. Yours is bent slightly to the left and always has been.

name: The Widow's Needle

will.name: Sixth Aunt Lu
voice: The needle is cold in a way that has nothing to do with the weather.
You get the distinct sense of being assessed, and found early.
Something in the hilt settles, the way a person settles when they have decided to allow something.

description: Rank three. Far past your grasp, and it knows it. An embroidery needle long enough to be a sword, which is exactly what it was.

name: First Frost

will.name: unnamed
voice: It goes exactly where you meant it to go, which is somehow worse.
For a moment you can feel the whole length of it, and how little of that length is yours.

description: The tournament prize. Rank five, presented on a stand, in front of everybody, for being excellent. You will be at the third realm for a long time yet.
